posts.post_subject: Latest DCG - Oh no!! Not another Chess Piece!!
posts.content_md:
My friend wanted a chess piece hologram for Christmas, go figure. Anyway – Homebrew DCG: 315M –image planed reflection H2 from PFG-3C reflection master. 

Now I know what “they” meant when they say PFG-03C shrinks if not tanned, the master when lit with an expanded beam was half black and only the center of the plate would replay at the original ref angle. Fortunately it did not obscure what I needed for the transfer hologram.
